text.en:
The percentage of net earnings to be declared and remitted
by the MWSS as dividends to the National Government as provided for under

of Republic Act No. 7656 is adjusted from at least fifty percent (50%) to
thirty percent (30%).
SEC 2. The adjusted dividend rate provided for under Section 1 are only
applicable on 2001 net earnings of the MWSS.
Path Holegram • 17662

2
SEC 3. This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this /3th day of
year of Our Lord, two thousand three.
By the President:
ALBERTO G. ROMULO
Executive Secretary
